individualFindings.evidence: The non-null disposition branch permits complete to become in-progress; concurrent down callers record before acquiring the provisioning lease and can recreate tracking.
DownCore reads only active state while RecordTestOutcome already uses owner.json; missing/malformed active JSON skips durable cleanup updates despite successful deletion.
The result is marked complete before DeleteStateAfterCleanupAsync; a false return or lock failure writes incomplete only to active state, leaving inconsistent dispositions.
New FindOwned traversal calls synchronous File.OpenRead and unbounded JSON parsing; a FIFO blocks before cancellation can be observed. Existing nonblocking bounded primitives are available.
RemoveAsync overwrites its last observation with a failed-discovery result, so known container IDs disappear without verified absence.
RecordTestOutcome rewrites native.trx and functional-observations.json with non-atomic byte writes after those files are referenced by published hashes; interruption can corrupt retained results.
A callback exception prevents NativeTestExecutionResult from returning its timestamp; the service then starts a fresh stopping allowance instead of using the original observation.
Typed JSON deserialization accepts a null nested terminalOutcome; enumeration checks only top-level fields, and listing dereferences it outside the structured refusal handler.
Human formatting omits the documented attempt identity while JSON carries it; this is a direct output correction.
The referenced lifecycle diagnostic persists discoveryUnverified but drops the producer discovery categories; the versioned result cannot explain which observation failed.
The advertised offline audit calls exists on the original absolute temporary result paths, so retained evidence alone cannot be audited from another checkout.
The external harness reproduced complete becoming in-progress and tracking reappearing after a stale cleanup callback; initial down records before lease acquisition make the overlap reachable.
Both DownCore state reads can observe an expired shared stopping token; the initial read lost its exception handler, so bounded cleanup throws rather than returning retryable uncertainty.
The external harness removed active state and reproduced successful empty cleanup with the surviving result still not-requested/failure-retained; durable owner metadata is available.
Pre-verified gap: restoring the source-only command condition escapes source-only command cases and package engine tests that force RetainOnFailure=true.
Pre-verified gap: deleting the executor snapshot assignment still yields reader-valid partial results, and no result assertion compares populated bindings to the original descriptor.

Patch audit: requiring CreatedAt/ExecutionContext rejected legitimate ordinary run/debug and legacy owner snapshots. InitializeState intentionally leaves test context unavailable for those runs. Optional identity validation preserves ownership without inventing fields.

Full post-review run: FailedBookkeepingStillStopsOwnedProcessAsync(diagnostics) loses HXT008 and exact-owner teardown because cleanup-lock directory publication fails before the sweep. The current bound must still protect best-effort runtime deletion and return recording failure.
DownStopsOnlyTaggedResourcesAsync uses literal workspace w, which is invalid under the existing exact-owner path invariant. Correct the fixture path while retaining tagged/foreign process assertions.

Three non-retaining selected startup tests require active tracking after verified cleanup. Their persistent summary, first cause and original deadline must instead be asserted through retained v1 results after tracking deletion; legacy assertions remain.

A full run exposed the token-at-delegate-entry timing assertion as scheduler-sensitive. A 500 ms cancellable operation distinguishes the original exhausted allowance from a renewed full allowance; the original timestamp and elapsed assertions remain. Five repeated focused runs passed.

routing: Each correction is local to existing behavior, adds no public surface and covers a demonstrated state. No intent gap, specification amendment or deferral is required.
patchStatus: All corrections verified by the 534-case affected suite and fresh real-service lifecycle proof
